import json, sys
import mod.client.extraClientApi as api
saved = sys._shield_banner_geometry_r20
node = api.GetTopUINode()
assert node is not None and not saved['controls']
saved['node'] = node
for index, row in enumerate(saved['rows']):
    control = node.CreateChildControl('PyreactBase.paperDoll', 'r20v5_' + row['label'], None, True)
    assert control is not None
    control.SetPosition((125. + 50. * index, 62.))
    control.SetSize((80., 140.))
    control.SetLayer(100)
    control.SetVisible(True)
    doll = control.asNeteasePaperDoll()
    assert doll is not None
    saved['controls'].append({'control': control, 'doll': doll, 'model': row['model'], 'label': row['label']})
control = node.CreateChildControl('PyreactBase.item', 'r20v5_native_item', None, True)
assert control is not None
control.SetPosition((280., 90.))
control.SetSize((60., 100.))
control.SetLayer(100)
control.SetVisible(True)
item = saved['rows'][0]['item']
returned = control.asItemRenderer().SetUiItem('minecraft:banner', item['newAuxValue'], False, item['userData'])
assert returned
saved['native_item_control'] = control
_result = json.dumps({'controls': len(saved['controls']), 'native_item': item, 'native_ui_returned': returned})
